# HomePowerRebate

HomePowerRebate helps British Columbia homeowners protect their families from power outages — and earn up to $10,000 from BC Hydro's Power Smart 2.0 rebate program. An approved home battery keeps the fridge, lights, and heat pump running when the grid goes down. Solar charges the battery and pays it back with rebates and lower bills. We match each homeowner with one approved local installer per city — never multiple companies — and the service is free for homeowners.

## What we do

- Match BC homeowners with one approved solar + battery installer per city (not a lead auction)
- Cover 11 British Columbia cities: Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Kamloops, Kelowna, Nanaimo, Prince George, Squamish, Surrey, Vancouver, Vernon, Victoria
- Provide a free 60-second savings calculator that estimates 10-year value
- Help homeowners understand the BC Hydro Power Smart 2.0 program
- Handle BC Hydro paperwork through our installer partners

## Key program facts (BC Hydro Power Smart 2.0)

- BC Hydro solar rebate: Up to $5,000 per home ($1,000 per kW of installed capacity, capped at 50% of cost)
- BC Hydro battery rebate: Up to $5,000 per home (requires Peak Saver enrollment)
- Combined solar + battery rebate: Up to $10,000 per home
- Peak Saver enrollment incentive: Up to $500 one-time when battery is enrolled
- Peak Saver seasonal reward: Up to $250 per winter season for enrolled batteries
- 10-year typical Peak Saver value: approximately $3,000
- Eligible utility: BC Hydro residential account holders only
- Not eligible: FortisBC customers, Tesla Powerwall batteries
- Approved installers: HPCN (Home Performance Contractor Network) certified, required from June 1, 2026
- Rate schedule change: BC Hydro Schedule 1289 transitions to 2289 on July 1, 2026
- Total Power Smart 2.0 budget: $1.1 billion over 3 years

## Why Tesla Powerwall is not eligible

Tesla products are not on BC Hydro's approved battery list. Installing a Tesla Powerwall in BC means the homeowner receives zero rebate. Approved alternatives include Eguana Evolve (Canadian-engineered), Enphase IQ, LG Home, SolarEdge Home, Panasonic EverVolt, and Generac PWRcell.

## The battery we install

Our installer partners across BC install the Eguana Evolve battery system. It is Canadian-engineered, designed for cold-climate performance (including Northern BC winters), on BC Hydro's approved list, and qualifies for the full $5,000 battery rebate when enrolled in Peak Saver.

## 10-year value by city

- Kamloops: ~$22,000 (best sun in BC, 6-9 yr payback)
- Vernon: ~$21,000 (North Okanagan sun, 6-10 yr payback)
- Kelowna: ~$20,000 (Central Okanagan, 7-11 yr payback)
- Abbotsford: ~$20,000 (Fraser Valley, 8-11 yr payback)
- Chilliwack: ~$20,000 (Fraser Valley East, 8-11 yr payback)
- Prince George: ~$20,500 (Northern BC, strong summer sun, 7-10 yr payback)
- Nanaimo: ~$19,500 (Central Vancouver Island, 8-11 yr payback)
- Victoria: ~$19,000 (Vancouver Island South, 8-11 yr payback)
- Squamish: ~$19,000 (Sea-to-Sky, 8-11 yr payback)
- Vancouver: ~$18,500 (Metro Vancouver, 9-12 yr payback)
- Surrey: ~$18,500 (Metro Vancouver South, 9-12 yr payback)

## How it works

1. Homeowner uses our on-page calculator to estimate their savings (60 seconds, no email required)
2. Homeowner submits a short form with contact info
3. We route the lead to one pre-approved local installer in their city
4. Installer calls within one business day with a free quote
5. Installer handles all BC Hydro paperwork; rebate cheque arrives 30-45 days after install

## Other Power Smart 2.0 rebates (BC Hydro, for reference)

- Heat pumps: Up to $4,000
- Heat pump water heaters: Up to $1,000
- Insulation upgrades: Up to $5,500
- Energy-efficient windows and doors: Up to $2,000
- Smart thermostats: Free for homes with electric baseboard heating

## About this service

HomePowerRebate is an independent installer matching service. We are not affiliated with BC Hydro. Homeowners pay nothing — our installer partners pay a referral fee only when a homeowner books an installation. We do not sell homeowner data to multiple installers; each lead goes to one installer only.
